title: oncall: add diagnostics helpers and SLO toolkit integration
author: Aisha Kapoor
description: Motivation: On-call responders frequently need a short, actionable diagnostics summary when an SLO alert fires. This PR adds a set of on-call diagnostics helpers to incident-bot that integrate with the slo-toolkit utilities to surface recent burn rate, relevant runbook links, and quick diagnostic commands. Goals: 1) Provide a concise diagnostics block in alert messages and the on-call Slack flow; 2) Make it easy to link to runbooks and SLO contexts; 3) Keep external calls rate-limited and add retries to avoid flakiness. What this changes: - new helpers exposed behind a feature flag `oncall.diagnostics.enabled` - lightweight SLO lookup and summarization in pkg/slo/toolkit - Slack template updates to render diagnostics block with runbook links and top-3 suggested checks - added integration and unit tests, telemetry counters and tracing spans Backwards compatibility: no breaking API changes; feature disabled by default. Checklist: - [x] Add SLO summarization util and caching - [x] Add Slack template + rendering tests - [x] Add retries + rate-limit wrapper for external SLO queries - [x] Add unit/integration tests - [x] Add feature flag and config docs - [x] Update changelog and release notes
commits_summary: 4 commits: initial helpers + tests; add retry and rate-limit wrapper; tweak slack formatting and i18n keys; add telemetry and docs updates
review_comments: Marco Ruiz: Nice work — can we avoid making a blocking external call during initial message rendering? Suggest adding a short cache and async refresh.
Aisha Kapoor: Added pkg/slo/toolkit/cache.go with a small in-memory TTL cache and fallbacks. If no data is available we render a graceful placeholder and attach a link to fetch details.
Priya Natarajan: Tests look good. Please add exponential backoff and cap retries to avoid thundering herd when SLO API is flaky.
Aisha Kapoor: Implemented retry with capped exponential backoff and jitter (configurable via defaults.yaml). Added unit tests that assert backoff is respected.
Tom Allen: Slack formatting nit — shorten the header and ensure runbook links are sanitized to avoid long URLs breaking layout.
Aisha Kapoor: Updated templates and added sanitization helper; added e2e Slack formatting test that asserts line length limits.
Marco Ruiz: Approving after CI green — left minor suggestion about telemetry metric naming, low-risk to address in follow-up.
Merge: Squash-and-merge by Marco Ruiz on 2024-11-18

merge_outcome: merged via squash on 2024-11-18 by Marco Ruiz
release_notes: Add on-call diagnostics helpers that surface SLO burn rate, runbook links, and suggested checks in incident-bot. Feature is behind config flag `oncall.diagnostics.enabled` and disabled by default.
notes: This PR was motivated by repeated on-call feedback during the Oct SLO incidents. Follow-up work: address Marco's telemetry naming suggestion and add a small dashboard tile in Redwood Console to track diagnostics lookup failure rate.
egress_risk: low — external SLO queries are rate-limited and cached; feature off by default
